parameters.query:
SELECT *,
MATCH(name_khong_dau) AGAINST ('{{ $json.originalText_khong_dau }}' IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) AS relevance
FROM tasks
WHERE MATCH(name_khong_dau) AGAINST ('{{ $json.originalText_khong_dau }}' IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
OR name_khong_dau LIKE CONCAT('%', '{{ $json.originalText_khong_dau }}', '%')
ORDER BY relevance DESC, date_updated DESC
LIMIT 100;

Không được gõ task không. Phải kèm theo nội dung ví dụ /task bí ẹo

parameters.query:
-- $1 là từ khóa (ví dụ: 'hnd duc duyet')
SELECT t.*,
       ts_rank(
         to_tsvector('simple', COALESCE(t.name_khong_dau, $1 )),
         websearch_to_tsquery('simple', 'hnd')
       ) AS relevance
FROM clickup.tasks t
WHERE to_tsvector('simple', COALESCE(t.name_khong_dau,'')) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $1 )
   OR t.name_khong_dau ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
ORDER BY relevance DESC NULLS LAST,
         date_updated DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100;
